content_of_post_to_answer: Does a city feel more liveable when the pace of life matches your own personal speed?
answer: Yes, but the fit is less about a city being fast or slow and more about how much effort it takes to live at your natural pace. In a rushed city, a reflective person may feel constantly behind; in a quiet one, an ambitious person may feel constrained. I explore this relationship between environment and inner rhythm more on my profile, because the real question is whether a place lets you live deliberately rather than constantly adjust.
